text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон and I have come to watch
the Arima
Kinen, and Nakayama
Racecourse is teeming with
an unusually
high level of excitement...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Coming through!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Gyah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, I'm fine. I just got bumped a
little.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But look how many people are here
today... It's a
struggle just to move
around.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I should be used to it by now, but
somehow the
Arima Kinen's popularity
always impresses me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Well, it is the huge end-of-year race.

text_block_list.text:
With all the year's top performers taking
the
field, the Arima Kinen is the perfect
way to cap
off a year of racing for many
fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, until last year, I used to feel like
the
concert after the Arima Kinen
marked the end of
the year, too...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But the Tokyo Daishoten is even closer to the end of the year!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's also a huge end-of-year race.
I wonder
if we could get all the people
here to go there
too.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: This year will be even bigger than last year.

text_block_list.text: Even bigger...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You're right! ☆ We even handed out all
those
flyers, so this ye—
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oh! Everyone's finally coming out!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oooh! Those two look so elegant.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You can tell they're all laser-focused.
This is
gonna be an awesome race!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
As she predicted, the race turns into an
epic
showdown sure to go down in
history.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The crowd favorite, Дайва Скарлет, leads
the
pack. She sets the pace and fends
off her frantic
pursuers, until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We have a winner! Number thirteen,
Daaaaiwaaa
Scaaaaarlet!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She goes on to shine as this year's queen
of the
grand prix, besting the
competition with
overwhelming strength!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooow!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Scarlet was super cool!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we're going to feel that passion
at the
winning concert too!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me! We need to get
front-row
seats!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Duh!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Let's dive in! Woohoo!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The winning concert is just as
overwhelming, and
Smart Falcon and I
watch from the front row.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your support
today,
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
I'm Дайва Скарлет, the number one

Umamusume! ♪
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!
Дайва Скарлет!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Phew! That was intense!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Scarlet was really shining up there.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But that's not all. I could feel her almost,
like,
commanding everyone to keep
their eyes on her.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She had the entire audience under her
spell.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The top runners really are in a league of
their
own...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I can do it. I know I can.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make the Tokyo Daishoten a
race to
remember, just like what we saw
today!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It'll be all right. I mean, dirt races are
just as fun.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Plus, we've done everything we possibly
can. I
made my declaration and put tons
of effort into
my performances...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: So yeah... It's gonna be fine.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It sounds a bit like Смарт Фалкон is trying
to
convince herself. But then, an instant
later, her
eyes start beaming with hope.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The peak of the dirt world is right in
front of us!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so begins our classic-year Tokyo
Daishoten!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
